Prototype for fd_dev_main with config and topology initialization arguments.

# Purpose
This header file declares the interface for the device boot entry point used by the application startup code. It includes the shared configuration headers and defines the [`fd_dev_main`](<#fd_dev_main>) function prototype, which takes command-line arguments, a Firedancer mode flag, a list of configuration files, and a topology initialization callback. The file uses include guards to prevent multiple inclusion and wraps the declaration in `FD_PROTOTYPES_BEGIN` and `FD_PROTOTYPES_END` for C and C++ compatibility.
